snippet.title: GTA 6 is gunna be a problem…
snippet.description:
🐑 Become a sacrificial lamb. Join the News Daddy Patreon: https://patreon.com/DylanPage?utm_medium=unknown&utm_source=join_link&utm_campaign=creatorshare_fan&utm_content=copyLink

🎮 GTA 6 EXTENDED LOOK: TOP 10 FEATURES
We just got nearly 30 minutes of never-before-seen GTA 6 footage and boys, we are in big trouble, it looks that good. We run through the 10 most exciting things we now know: the insane graphics, the open-world mini-games, character physique that changes with workouts, an 80-hour playthrough, a choice-driven storyline where your actions carry weight, the Jason and Lucia relationship system, a map double the size of GTA V, over 600,000 NPC animations, advanced in-game social media, and confirmation of nearly every leak.

🕷️ ISHOWSPEED AS SPIDER-MAN?
A tweet caught my attention claiming Speed is set to play Miles Morales in Avengers Secret Wars. I dug into the source and got bad news, no credible outlet is actually reporting this, and the account behind it has a history of shitposting. But now the idea's in my head, I don't hate it. We get into why Speed can actually act, the open Miles Morales casting, and whether it'd be a good fit or ruin the character.

🌊 THE FULL NEPAL FLOOD DISASTER
Some of the most shocking footage I've seen in half a decade of covering news. Entire villages, bridges and buildings were consumed after flash flooding triggered an enormous mudslide in Nepal, with boulders the size of buildings swept along in the current. We cover the scale of the devastation, the more than 1,300 missing, the rescue effort, and the freak chain of events behind it: a collapsing glacier that registered as a 5.2 magnitude earthquake, and the bigger question of why it happened and whether more are coming.

📱 META GETS AWAY WITH IT AGAIN
Remember the $1 trillion lawsuit that could have forced Instagram and Facebook to end infinite scroll, ditch stories and make their algorithms less addictive? Meta just settled for $17 billion, less than 20% of their annual revenue, and avoided going to court to face the evidence. We get into how the early settlement came about, the minor changes they actually have to make, and why it feels like they paid their way through the justice system.

⚖️ UEFA PREPARES CRIMINAL ACTION AGAINST INFANTINO
While the US states settled, UEFA absolutely refuses to let FIFA president Infantino off the hook. Reports say UEFA is preparing criminal legal proceedings over his plans to sell off stakes of the World Cup to private investors. At this point it's hard to see how FIFA survives the next four years to the next World Cup.

🔒 THE TATES BEG TO AVOID PRISON
Andrew and Tristan Tate are in bigger trouble than ever. They appeared in a Florida court shackled in jail uniforms, with Tristan complaining he's lost weight and calling the conditions "death by scurvy," begging to be released on bail to fight extradition to the UK, where 59 charges could keep them locked up for life. We get into the flight-risk arguments over their multiple passports and why it's not looking good for them.

🕊️ A WEEK OF DEVASTATING LOSSES
So many public figures passed away this week. We pay respects to legendary Hollywood stunt performer James Lew at 73, Dolly Parton at 80, Tim Curry (Pennywise in the original It and The Rocky Horror Show), Peter Cullen (the voice of Optimus Prime), and King Harald V of Norway, Europe's oldest reigning monarch, at 89.

📜 TODAY IN HISTORY: AUGUST 29
Our recurring segment returns. We get into August 29th through history: Michael Jackson born in Gary, Indiana in 1958; Netflix launching in 1997 by mailing DVDs (sharing a birthday with the King of Pop before it became the king of streaming); the first Guinness World Records book in 1955; and Martin Luther King Jr's "I Have a Dream" speech delivered to over 200,000 people.

Watch This Alita vs Terminator Iron Judgment Concept Trailer 

What if a cybernetic warrior with no memory and a relentless killing machine from a forgotten war were both awakened by the same signal inside a shattered megacity, and the weapon fused inside her chest is the one thing neither a warlord nor an unstoppable assassin will stop hunting until they have it?

This fan-made concept trailer imagines Alita vs Terminator Iron Judgment for 2027 where Will Smith stars as Rex Harlan, a haunted former combat engineer who discovers a destroyed cyborg body in the ruins of a sprawling junkyard megacity called The Heap and rebuilds her in his underground workshop, giving her a name, Alita. snippet.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui – 15 Minutes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
With blood beneath my blade, I paint new rouge upon my face,
An old friend visits, in a dream taking place.
Old faces, bygone deeds, have vanished from my sight,
Still, I remember every one, by day and through the night.
Those bound by love grow old; the righteous road runs long;
Today's notes of grace or grudge define not the final song.
Who says the Underworld is far away? 
All the better—once more I'll walk along.

Today, Game Science unveils a brand-new 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second title in the Black Myth series. The trailer offers a first look at the protagonist in combat, along with a glimpse of the story.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

Official Website: https://gamesci.cn/zhongkui
